title: Find a runnable check and read its results

steps.text: The catalogue lists every evaluation, grouped by pillar. The counts under the title say how many can run today.
The list starts on runnable evaluations only. Those are the ones with an engine behind them.
Switch the engine filter to see the entries that are listed but have no engine yet.
Click an evaluation name to open its panel with the metric, threshold and results by system.
Each system shows its latest result and the evidence it came from.
